description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans SiloBuilder, including mock implementations, configuration validation tests, and startup behavior tests. It verifies correct configuration, error handling, and service registration for Orleans silos within a test suite.

classes.name: NoOpMembershipTable
classes.description: A mock implementation of IMembershipTable used for testing, with all methods either completing immediately or throwing NotImplementedException.

classes.name: SiloBuilderTests
classes.description: Contains multiple unit tests verifying the configuration and startup behavior of Orleans silos, including validation of options, error conditions, and service registration.

methods.name: SiloBuilderTest
methods.description: Tests that a basic silo can be configured and started with localhost clustering and essential options.

methods.name: SiloBuilder_GrainCollectionOptionsForZeroSecondsAgeLimitTest
methods.description: Verifies that configuring GrainCollectionOptions with a zero seconds age limit throws an OrleansConfigurationException.

methods.name: SiloBuilder_ClusterMembershipOptionsValidators
methods.description: Checks that invalid ClusterMembershipOptions configurations (NumVotesForDeathDeclaration >= NumProbedSilos or zero votes) throw exceptions.

methods.name: SiloBuilder_LoadSheddingValidatorAbove100ShouldFail
methods.description: Ensures that setting LoadSheddingOptions.CpuThreshold above 100 results in an OrleansConfigurationException.

methods.name: SiloBuilderThrowsDuringStartupIfNoGrainsAdded
methods.description: Verifies that starting a silo without registered grain classes or interfaces throws an exception.

methods.name: SiloBuilderThrowsDuringStartupIfClientBuildersAdded
methods.description: Checks that configuring both a client and a silo in the same host throws an exception.

methods.name: SiloBuilderWithHotApplicationBuilderThrowsDuringStartupIfClientBuildersAdded
methods.description: Verifies that using the Host.CreateApplicationBuilder API to configure both client and silo throws an exception.
